description: Get futures chart data including open interest, volume, funding rate history, liquidations, long/short ratios, basis, term structure, and OHLCV. OI rows sum every contract a venue stored that hour; a row with `oi_contracts` holds another number of contracts than the venue's newest hour (`oi_contracts_latest`): fewer is partial, and a change across two counts is coverage, not positions. Time series are oldest-first; when one exceeds the response cap its newest rows are kept (truncated_fields marks kept: latest). Without limit, oi-snapshot returns each exchange's latest reading; pass limit/cursor to page raw rows oldest-first. chart=cvd returns candle rows with `cvd_delta_usd` and the running `cvd_usd` (CVD = running sum of (2 * taker_buy_volume - volume) * close; only Binance candles carry taker volume). Liquidation quantity is already USD notional (never multiply by price). Composite charts return their raw input legs tagged `_type`, plus server-computed values: funding-cost settlement rows carry `funding_paid_usd` (USD the settlement moved, + = longs paid; absent when no OI prices it), crowding-risk adds per-bucket Binance price rows with `crowding_score` (−100 crowded shorts … +100 crowded longs; null when a leg is missing), and oi-snapshot rows carry `oi_share` (0-1 share of the listed venues' latest OI, each venue's latest row). returns-* return raw 1h candles.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

exchanges.description: Comma-separated list of exchanges to include (e.g. Binance,Bybit).

limit.description: Maximum number of data points per page.

name: get_futures_data

basis_apr.description: The contract's basis annualized over `days_to_expiry`, a fraction per year (0.0604 is 6.04%).

_type.description: Composite charts only: which input leg the row is. perp-dislocation = basis + funding + oi; funding-cost = funding + oi; crowding-risk = funding + oi + long-short (account rows) + ohlcv (Binance candles); flow-confirmation = ohlcv + oi (Binance); carry-curve = term-structure + funding (each venue's latest settlement). The server computes funding-cost's `funding_paid_usd` and crowding-risk's `crowding_score` (on untagged Binance bucket rows) from these legs; the other composites' signals are computed by the client from them. Also on oi-volume's open-interest rows when they come from the live venue fallback. Absent elsewhere.

basis_rate.description: Instantaneous perp premium: (perp mark − spot) / spot, as a fraction. For an annualized dated-futures basis use chart=annualized-basis (basis_apr).

status.description: "partial" when a database read failed or timed out after some rows arrived, or stopped at its row cap, so the oldest rows in the window can be missing; warnings says which. Omitted when every read completed.

warnings.description: One sentence per gap: an incomplete database read, a read stopped at its row cap, an open-interest history (oi-stacked, oi-change, oi-daily-change) above 30,000 rows resampled per venue to 2-, 4-, 6-, 12- or 24-hour buckets (last value per venue) to fit the response, an open-interest bucket that is the current (still filling) hour, or chart=cvd venues whose candles carry no taker buy volume.

openInterestExcludedVenues.description: Open-interest charts only (oi-stacked, oi-change, oi-daily-change, oi-snapshot): venues whose rows are shown per venue but must not be summed into a total, with the reason.

FuturesOiSummary.description: chart=oi-snapshot only: the coin's open interest summed across venues, computed by the server from the rows it returns.

oi_as_of.description: The oldest reading inside `oi_total_usd` (each venue's latest reading is hour-bucketed).

oi_excluded_venues.description: Venues that have a reading for this coin but are left out of the total, with the reason (MEXC today).

oi_null_reason.description: Why `oi_total_usd` is null (`no_eligible_inputs`: no venue reading within 6 hours). Present only then.

oi_total_usd.description: The coin's one-sided open interest across venues (engine L4 `oi.asset_total`): each venue's latest reading within 6 hours, summed, rounded to whole USD. Venues in `oi_excluded_venues` are left out. Null when no venue has a reading within 6 hours (`oi_null_reason`).

FuturesPriceOverlayPoint.description: Binance closes joined into `data` beside the chart's rows, without an `exchange`: filter them out before summing venue rows. v1 only, on oi-stacked and liquidations: each candle's close as a price overlay. Both routes, on crowding-risk: one row per score bucket (`timeframe` 8h, or 1d past 45 days of rows; `timestamp` its start; `close` the bucket's last Binance close) carrying `crowding_score`, null where a leg or the prior bucket is missing.

price.description: Always null: the hourly buckets carry no fill price.

quantity.description: USD notional liquidated on this side in the hour bucket starting at `timestamp` (Binance and Bybit from our own capture of their liquidation streams, Deribit from Velo; OKX is not served because its series is a delayed, partial sample of OKX's liquidations, not their total). Already in USD: do not multiply by a price. The newest hour is still accumulating.

LongShortPoint.description: long-short-ratio: the venue's account ratio (all accounts). top-trader-ls: the venue's top traders, with `exchange` suffixed `_top_trader`. The two populations are never mixed in one chart.

cvd_delta_usd.description: chart=cvd, candles with taker volume only: (taker buy − taker sell) × close = (2 × taker_buy_volume − volume) × close, USD.

cvd_usd.description: chart=cvd, candles with taker volume only: the venue's cumulative volume delta, the running sum of `cvd_delta_usd` from the window's first candle, USD.

taker_buy_volume.description: Base-asset taker buy volume; null where the venue publishes none (only Binance candles carry it today, so CVD exists only for Binance).

timestamp.description: The candle's open (bucket start). Only closed candles are stored, so the newest candle can be up to ~2 hours old.

volume.description: Base-asset volume of the candle (not USD).

volume_usd.description: Aggregated candles only (the downsampled 4h/1d buckets the web terminal's charts read; `/v1` serves the stored candles and omits it): the sum of each source candle's volume × its close. Null when a source candle lacks either.

OpenInterestExclusion.description: A venue whose stored open interest is published per venue but left out of every cross-venue total, and why. MEXC and BingX today: MEXC's holdVol moves 7.00x the position change of its own deal feed, so it fits neither side count; BingX's figure moved faster than its own trades allow and is no longer read, so only its stored history remains.

open_interest_value.description: One-sided open interest in USD at the sampled price: a change between two rows includes the price move, not only positions opened or closed.

timestamp.description: The UTC hour bucket (its start). The value is the last ~10-minute sample the capture saw inside that hour, so it is about the OI at the bucket's END (it lines up with Binance openInterestHist at the next hour). The newest bucket is still filling while its hour runs; coverage.warnings names it.

The server computes funding-cost's `funding_paid_usd` and crowding-risk's `crowding_score` (on untagged Binance bucket rows) from these legs; the other composites' signals are computed by the client from them. Also on oi-volume's open-interest rows when they come from the live venue fallback. Absent elsewhere.

basis_rate.description: The contract's basis to expiry (futures over spot, minus 1), a fraction (0.0149 is 1.49%). Null on Velo's synthetic 3-month rows (`contract_symbol` ending in `-VELO-3M-BASIS`), which store an annualized figure in its place: `basis_apr` keeps it.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.
